subject.title: fix: Node allowlist writeback can restore revoked exec approvals

question: Should this PR keep the new fail-closed stale-lock behavior across the public plugin SDK, Node, and macOS approval writers before merge?
rationale: The fail-closed choice improves security by avoiding unsafe pathname-based stale-lock deletion, but it also changes a public SDK recovery behavior and can require operator cleanup when stale lock ownership cannot be verified.

options.title: Keep fail-closed with proof
options.body: Accept the compatibility and availability tradeoff after the PR removes the changelog entry and posts exact-head real behavior proof for the approval race and stale-lock failure mode.

options.title: Narrow fail-closed scope
options.body: Limit fail-closed recovery to exec approval persistence and preserve the current public plugin SDK stale-lock behavior until a separate SDK compatibility decision lands.

options.title: Pause for lock-owner design
options.body: Hold this PR until the lock-library owner can provide an atomic stale recovery design that avoids both stale policy overwrite and operator cleanup regressions.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed with proof
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility and availability tradeoff after the PR removes the changelog entry and posts exact-head real behavior proof for the approval race and stale-lock failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and authored the present head that implements the fail-closed locking direction.
